messages:
leah: FYI - automated RBAC reconcile ran at 2026-03-29T18:05 UTC and applied a conditional binding that inadvertently scoped KMS signer/unwrapper grants to 'resource.region==eu'. We're seeing cross-region mTLS failures from NA->APAC where connectors can't unwrap keys or get ephemeral certs. Major impact to inter-region traffic. :rotating_light:

omar: Example log from connector-apac-2:
```
2026-03-29T18:07:12Z connector-apac-2 audit=crypto DENY unwrap key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/edge/cryptoKeys/edge-keystore-v5 labels=[env:prod,region:apac] principal=svc-account:connector-na@dataplane reason=conditionNotMet
TLS alert: KEY_UNWRAP_FAILURE
```
Downstream: 502 handshake_fail
```

priya: And minting errors from cert-mint (na-east):
```
2026-03-29T18:06:58Z cert-mint error=asymmetricSign DENY key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/signing/cryptoKeys/ca-sign-v2 principal=svc-account:mint-service@prod reason=conditionNotMet
requestId=abcd-1234
```
Result: cert issuance 502 -> client certs invalidated.

kms-audit-bot: policy-change "rbac-reconcile-2026-03-29" applied by @deploy-bot at 2026-03-29T18:05:01Z. Note: conditional binding added (resource.region==eu). Runbook: revert or widen condition if crypto ops fail.

leah: Rolling back the conditional binding now. Also enabling a temporary proxy fallback: `kubectl -n proxy annotate deploy/proxy keystore.fallback=enabled` to reduce immediate failures for in-flight sessions.

deploy-bot: change-window opened by @leah at 2026-03-29T18:08:10Z for rollback: rbac-reconcile-2026-03-29 -> previous-state. Recording: changelist-374000.

omar: Rollback complete at 18:09:20Z. KMS audit shows unwrap/asymmetricSign success for previously denied principals. Traffic recovered to baseline in ~80s.

priya: P0 mitigated. Immediate action items I propose: 
- Add KMS-deny log-based metrics: unwrap DENY and AsymmetricSign DENY aggregated by key and principal (thresholds: unwrap >5/min, sign >2/min). Pager -> sec-oncall.
- Add a CI preflight in policy automation that for any MR adding or modifying IAM conditions on keystore keys runs `gcloud kms keys test-iam-permissions` for decrypt/unwrap/asymmetricSign against an enumerated principal list across regions. If any principal returns DENY, fail the MR.
- Require a MR checklist item to declare whether the change touches keys labeled `critical:tls` or `role:ocsp` and require manual approval if so.

sec-oncall: Acknowledged. Opening incident ticket INC-8207 and scheduling 30m RCA. Please attach policy diff, KMS audit export 18:00-18:15 UTC, and deploy calendar entry. We'll make conditional-bound changes pagerable until CI preflight exists.

leah: Additional follow-ups: avoid applying RBAC reconcile/automation at the same time as TLS config hardening. Add a deploy gating rule: do not run both within a 24h window. Also, add key-label alias metadata so callers can reference either canonical or alias names during migrations.

omar: I'll draft the CI job that enumerates principals by scanning recent KMS audit logs (`protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail`) and runs testIamPermissions across regions. It will be an opt-out for very large MR batches.

kms-audit-bot: incident/8207 created and artifacts archived to /incidents/8207/. All actions logged.

priya: Final note: treating KMS DENY reason 'conditionNotMet' as a distinct signal is important — it indicates policy-level scoping issues (IAM condition mistakes) vs permission misassignment. We'll add that to the RCA taxonomy.
